pages.text: A twisted amalgamation of flesh and dark magic, born from the Breeding Nest.$(br2)With a trivial amount of souls, it can be transformed into loyal Illager servants — or forced into service at half health if souls are scarce.$(br2)Alternatively, place it in a Flesh Furnace to forge an even stronger army.$(br2)$(o)But be warned: servants spawned from a Twisted Embryo cannot learn magic.$()

pages.title: Obtaining
pages.text: Twisted Embryos are not crafted — they are produced by the Breeding Nest. Feed the Nest any food that restores hunger to generate Twisted Embryos.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: $(bold)Servant Summoning$()$(br)Using a Squad Focus, consume souls to transform Twisted Embryos into loyal Illager servants. If souls are insufficient, forced summoning is still possible — but the servant will spawn at half health.$(br2)$(bold)Flesh Furnace$()$(br)Cook the Twisted Embryo in a Flesh Furnace to obtain a Mature Embryo, capable of training more formidable troops.$(br2)$(bold)Limitation$()$(br)Servants spawned from Twisted Embryos cannot learn or cast magic.
